---
pagetitle: "Contact — OpenSpace"
description-meta: "Get in touch with the OpenSpace team — send a message or join us on Slack."
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
    toc: false
    anchor-sections: false
---

```{=html}
<section class="contact-hero">
  <nav class="page-breadcrumb" aria-label="Breadcrumb">
    <span class="bc-parent">Community</span>
    <span class="bc-sep">›</span>
    <span class="bc-current">Contact</span>
  </nav>
  <div>
    <h1>Get in touch</h1>
    <p class="contact-hero-lede">Have a question, bug report, or want to learn more? We're happy to help.</p>
  </div>
</section>

<div class="contact-body">

  <!-- ── Form ── -->
  <div class="contact-form-wrap">
    <h2>Send a message</h2>
    <form id="contact-form" novalidate>
      <div class="cf-field">
        <label for="cf-name">Name</label>
        <input type="text" id="cf-name" name="name" placeholder="Your name" autocomplete="name">
      </div>
      <div class="cf-field">
        <label for="cf-email">Email <span class="cf-required">*</span></label>
        <input type="email" id="cf-email" name="email" placeholder="your@email.com" autocomplete="email" required>
      </div>
      <div class="cf-field">
        <label for="cf-subject">Subject</label>
        <input type="text" id="cf-subject" name="subject" placeholder="What's this about?">
      </div>
      <div class="cf-field">
        <label for="cf-message">Message <span class="cf-required">*</span></label>
        <textarea id="cf-message" name="message" placeholder="Tell us what you need…" required></textarea>
      </div>
      <p class="cf-error" id="cf-error" hidden></p>
      <button type="submit" class="btn-primary-os">Send message</button>
      <p class="cf-note">This opens your email client with a pre-addressed message to support@openspaceproject.com.</p>
    </form>
  </div>

  <!-- ── Slack sidebar ── -->
  <div class="contact-slack-wrap">
    <h2>Also on Slack</h2>
    <p>For real-time help, the OpenSpace Slack is active with community members, educators, and developers.</p>
    <a class="btn-ghost-os" href="/community/slack.html">Join the Slack</a>
  </div>

</div>

<script>
(function () {
  var form = document.getElementById('contact-form');
  if (!form) return;

  form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    var errorEl = document.getElementById('cf-error');

    var email   = form.querySelector('#cf-email').value.trim();
    var message = form.querySelector('#cf-message').value.trim();

    if (!email || !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) {
      errorEl.textContent = 'Please enter a valid email address.';
      errorEl.hidden = false;
      return;
    }
    if (!message) {
      errorEl.textContent = 'Please enter a message.';
      errorEl.hidden = false;
      return;
    }
    errorEl.hidden = true;

    var name    = form.querySelector('#cf-name').value.trim();
    var subject = form.querySelector('#cf-subject').value.trim() || 'OpenSpace inquiry';
    var body    = (name ? 'From: ' + name + '\n' : '') +
                  'Email: ' + email + '\n\n' +
                  message;

    window.location.href = 'mailto:support@openspaceproject.com' +
      '?subject=' + encodeURIComponent(subject) +
      '&body='    + encodeURIComponent(body);
  });
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  var ref = document.referrer;
  if (!ref) return;
  var bc = document.querySelector('.page-breadcrumb');
  if (!bc) return;

  var trails = [
    { pattern: /\/about\/about-openspace/, section: 'About', page: 'About OpenSpace', pageHref: '/about/about-openspace.html' },
    { pattern: /\/about\/brand/,           section: 'About', page: 'Brand & Attribution', pageHref: '/about/brand.html' },
    { pattern: /\/about\/team/,            section: 'About', page: 'Team',           pageHref: '/about/team.html' },
    { pattern: /\/about\/partners/,        section: 'About', page: 'Partners',       pageHref: '/about/partners.html' },
    { pattern: /\/about\/impact/,          section: 'About', page: 'Impact',         pageHref: '/about/impact.html' },
    { pattern: /\/about\/research/,        section: 'About', page: 'Research',       pageHref: '/about/research.html' },
    { pattern: /\/about\/publications/,    section: 'About', page: 'Publications',   pageHref: '/about/publications.html' },
    { pattern: /\/community\/use-cases/,   section: 'Community', page: 'Use Cases',  pageHref: '/community/use-cases.html' },
    { pattern: /\/community\/events/,      section: 'Community', page: 'Events',     pageHref: '/community/events/' },
    { pattern: /\/community\/user-meetings/, section: 'Community', page: 'Annual Meetings', pageHref: '/community/user-meetings/' },
    { pattern: /\/community\/slack/,       section: 'Community', page: 'Slack',      pageHref: '/community/slack.html' },
    { pattern: /\/features\/display-support/,        section: 'Features', page: 'Display Support',        pageHref: '/features/display-support.html' },
    { pattern: /\/features\/globe-browsing/,         section: 'Features', page: 'Globe Browsing',         pageHref: '/features/globe-browsing.html' },
    { pattern: /\/features\/mission-visualizations/, section: 'Features', page: 'Mission Visualizations', pageHref: '/features/mission-visualizations.html' },
    { pattern: /\/features\/heliophysics/,            section: 'Features', page: 'Heliophysics',            pageHref: '/features/heliophysics.html' },
    { pattern: /\/install\/version-0220/,  section: 'Install', page: 'Version 0.22.0', pageHref: '/install/version-0220.html' },
    { pattern: /\/install\/previous/,      section: 'Install', page: 'Previous Versions', pageHref: '/install/previous-versions.html' },
  ];

  for (var i = 0; i < trails.length; i++) {
    var t = trails[i];
    if (t.pattern.test(ref)) {
      var midSpan = t.pageHref
        ? '<span class="bc-parent"><a href="' + t.pageHref + '">' + t.page + '</a></span>'
        : '<span class="bc-parent">' + t.page + '</span>';
      bc.innerHTML =
        '<span class="bc-parent">' + t.section + '</span>' +
        '<span class="bc-sep">›</span>' +
        midSpan +
        '<span class="bc-sep">›</span>' +
        '<span class="bc-current">Contact</span>';
      return;
    }
  }
})();
</script>
```
